# Telix Notice of General Meeting


**Melbourne (Australia)** **| October 30, 2026**


Telix today announces a General Meeting of shareholders to be held at The Events Centre, Level 5, Tower 2/727 Collins Street, Melbourne, VIC 3008 and online via[meetings.openbriefing.com/TLXMeeting2026](https://meetings.openbriefing.com/TLXMeeting2026) on Tuesday, December 1, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. (Melbourne time).


The shareholder pack, comprising the Notice of Meeting, Proxy Form and Online Guide can be accessed[here](https://telixpharma.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/20261030-TLX-Notice-of-General-Meeting-vFINAL.pdf) .
